name: MonarchRenewalsPanel
title: RenewalsPanel
wrapsNative: MonarchSectionCard with androidx.compose.material3.SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow and SegmentedButton for the filters, a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of rows (MonarchText, MonarchStatusBadge, MonarchBadge, MonarchMoney, MonarchButton), MonarchLoadingState, MonarchErrorState and MonarchEmptyState
summary: Upcoming renewals in a card: what renews or expires next, when, for how much and who owns it, with filter options, per-currency totals and a row action.
whenToUse: For a renewals workspace or dashboard card that lists contracts, licenses, subscriptions or domains reaching the end of their term, so someone can act before the date.
whenNotToUse: For the full list of a customer's subscriptions with prices and statuses, use MonarchSubscriptionsTable. For what unused items cost, use MonarchSavingsPanel.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchRenewalsPanel(items: List<MonarchRenewalItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, description: String? = null, filters: List<MonarchRenewalFilter> = emptyList(), selectedFilter: String? = null, totals: List<MonarchRenewalTotal> = emptyList(), unpricedCount: Int = 0, locale: Locale? = null, now: Long? = null, urgentWithinDays: Int = MonarchRenewalsPanelDefaults.URGENT_WITHIN_DAYS, registry: MonarchStatusRegistry? = null, loading: Boolean = false, error: String? = null, retrying: Boolean = false, onFilterChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onItemClick: ((MonarchRenewalItem) -> Unit)? = null, onItemAction: ((MonarchRenewalItem) -> Unit)? = null, canAct: ((MonarchRenewalItem) -> Boolean)? = null, actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchRenewalsPanelLabels = MonarchRenewalsPanelLabels())
object MonarchRenewalsPanelDefaults { const val URGENT_WITHIN_DAYS: Int = 14; @Composable fun statuses(): MonarchStatusRegistry }

class MonarchRenewalItem(id: String, name: String, status: String, renewalDateMillis: Long?, description: String? = null, daysUntil: Int? = null, noticeDeadlineMillis: Long? = null, amount: BigDecimal? = null, currencyCode: String? = null, amountNote: String? = null, autoRenew: Boolean? = null, probability: Int? = null, owner: String? = null, nextAction: String? = null, nextActionDateMillis: Long? = null, nextActionOverdue: Boolean = false, outcome: String? = null)
class MonarchRenewalTotal(currencyCode: String, amount: BigDecimal, count: Int, estimated: BigDecimal? = null)
class MonarchRenewalFilter(value: String, label: String, count: Int? = null)

class MonarchRenewalsPanelLabels(title: String? = null, list: String? = null, filters: String? = null, totals: String? = null, daysUntil: ((Int) -> String)? = null, noticeBy: ((String) -> String)? = null, unknownDate: String? = null, unpriced: String? = null, autoRenews: String? = null, manualRenewal: String? = null, noOwner: String? = null, noNextAction: String? = null, overdue: String? = null, dueSoon: String? = null, probability: ((Int) -> String)? = null, totalIn: ((String, Int) -> String)? = null, estimated: ((String) -> String)? = null, unpricedCount: String? = null, unpricedHint: String? = null, action: String? = null, actionFor: ((String, String) -> String)? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, errorTitle: String? = null, loading: String? = null)

options.name: items
options.description: The renewals in view, already filtered and sorted by the app.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the card.

options.name: title
options.description: The card title. null uses "Renewals".

options.name: description
options.description: Help text under the title.

options.name: filters
options.description: Filter options shown as a Material 3 segmented row, each with an optional count.

options.name: selectedFilter
options.description: The selected filter value; null selects the first option.

options.name: totals
options.description: Per-currency totals shown as tiles above the list; never converted or added across currencies.

options.name: unpricedCount
options.description: The number of items without a price, shown as a tile next to the totals.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of amounts and dates. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for day counts in epoch milliseconds; null reads the clock once when the panel first shows.

options.name: urgentWithinDays
options.description: Open renewals this many days away or fewer, or past, get the "Due soon" badge.

options.name: registry
options.description: More statuses, or replacements for open, in_progress, renewed, lost and void.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows a loading state in place of the totals and the list; the filters stay.

options.name: error
options.description: Shows the error state with this message; an empty string shows only the title. Wins over loading.

options.name: retrying
options.description: The retry of the error state is running.

options.name: onFilterChange
options.description: Called with the value of the chosen filter.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error state.

options.name: onItemClick
options.description: Makes each row's text a button that opens the item. Replaces the web href and renderLink.

options.name: onItemAction
options.description: Shows a small secondary row action, Update by default, called with the item.

options.name: canAct
options.description: Hides the row action for some items; null shows it for every item.

options.name: actions
options.description: Header actions of the card, such as a Check now button.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string.

states.name: rows
states.description: Each item shows its name, status badge, description, date with the day count or notice deadline, amount with its note and renewal mode, owner and next step when any item has them, and probability or outcome.

states.name: due soon
states.description: An open or in-progress item due within urgentWithinDays days, or past, shows a warning "Due soon" badge in words.

states.name: overdue next step
states.description: The next step is written "Overdue: …" in the strong danger color.

states.name: totals
states.description: Subtle tiles per currency ("USD · 4 renewals", the amount, the estimated part) and a tile for the items without a price.

states.name: loading
states.description: Skeleton rows named "Loading renewals" replace the totals and the list.

states.name: error
states.description: "Renewals could not be loaded." with the app's message and Try again.

states.name: empty
states.description: "No renewals coming up" with a message about the selected window.

appearance: A MonarchSectionCard: rows in the default and muted text colors separated by subtle dividers, status badges in their tones, the Due soon badge in the warning tone, totals on subtle tiles and the overdue step in the strong danger color. The same in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web RenewalsPanel is a section with a data table that hides columns as the container narrows, a SegmentedControl, ReactNode slots, links and a skeleton. On Android each item is a stacked row at every width, because a six-column table does not fit a phone and the plan named rows; the rows are a Column rather than a LazyColumn so the card can sit inside the screen's verticalScroll. Links (href, renderLink) become onItemClick. The urgent marker is a visible "Due soon" badge, because Monarch bundles no warning icon and the web's visually hidden text would leave the color alone. Dates are epoch milliseconds (UTC) written with android.icu.text.DateFormat; there is no timeZone parameter, and day counts use now or the clock read once, without ticking. The web filterControls and empty slots are not offered; replace the empty strings through labels. The default statuses are MonarchRenewalsPanelDefaults.statuses(), with localised labels. iOS has not built RenewalsPanel yet; the names follow the web.
accessibility: Each row's text is one TalkBack element read in words: name, status, Due soon, description, date and day count, amount, renewal mode, owner, next step, probability and outcome.
With onItemClick the row's text is a button with a 48dp minimum height and a focus ring.
The row action is a separate button read with the item's name: "Update Acme contract"; it keeps a 48dp touch target.
The list is a traversal group named "Renewals" with collection info; each row carries its index.
The filters are Material 3 segmented buttons with the selected state; the group is named "Filter renewals".
The totals are a traversal group named "Totals by currency"; each tile is read as one element.
Urgency and overdue steps are written in words, never shown by color alone.
Text wraps at font scale 2.0; right to left, the lines mirror.
edgeCases: An item's own daysUntil wins over the worked-out count; a missing date shows "Unknown date" and no count.
A past open renewal (negative days) is also marked Due soon.
Amounts are never converted; totals come from the app per currency.
An amount without a currency code is shown as "No price".
Many filters make the segmented row wrap its labels on a narrow phone; keep them few and short.

@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchRenewalsPanel(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchRenewalItem(
            id = {{items.0.id}},
            name = {{items.0.name}},
            status = {{items.0.status}},
            renewalDateMillis = {{items.0.renewalDate|millis}},
            description = {{items.0.description}},
            amount = BigDecimal("{{items.0.amount|raw}}"),
            currencyCode = {{items.0.currency}},
            amountNote = {{items.0.amountNote}},
            probability = {{items.0.probability}},
            owner = {{items.0.owner}},
            nextAction = {{items.0.nextAction}},
            nextActionDateMillis = {{items.0.nextActionDate|millis}},
            nextActionOverdue = {{items.0.nextActionOverdue}},
        ),
        MonarchRenewalItem(
            id = {{items.1.id}},
            name = {{items.1.name}},
            status = {{items.1.status}},
            renewalDateMillis = {{items.1.renewalDate|millis}},
            description = {{items.1.description}},
            noticeDeadlineMillis = {{items.1.noticeDeadline|millis}},
            autoRenew = {{items.1.autoRenew}},
        ),
    ),
    title = {{title}},
    description = {{description}},
    filters = listOf(
        MonarchRenewalFilter({{filters.0.value}}, {{filters.0.label}}),
        MonarchRenewalFilter({{filters.1.value}}, {{filters.1.label}}),
    ),
    selectedFilter = filter,
    totals = listOf(
        MonarchRenewalTotal({{totals.0.currency}}, BigDecimal("{{totals.0.amount|raw}}"), {{totals.0.count}}),
        MonarchRenewalTotal({{totals.1.currency}}, BigDecimal("{{totals.1.amount|raw}}"), {{totals.1.count}}),
    ),
    unpricedCount = {{unpricedCount}},
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
    now = {{now|millis}},
    onFilterChange = { filter = it },
    onItemAction = { /* Open the app's update dialog here. */ },
    actions = {
        MonarchButton(text = {{actionLabel}}, onClick = {}, size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm)
    },
)

parityExceptions.reason: The panel writes its dates as plain calendar days in UTC, which is the fixture time zone, so no time zone value is passed; a date at midnight UTC never moves to the previous day.
parityExceptions.convention: day-granular dates are written in UTC, so no zone parameter is needed

parityExceptions.reason: The phone shows each row as a card: the first column is the card title and every other cell carries its column name as a label, so the column header row is not drawn. TalkBack reads each cell with its column name.
parityExceptions.convention: a table is a list of cards on a phone (Material list-detail), not a header row
